description: This course is designed for students who have completed EE2211: Introduction to Machine Learning. It covers advanced topics in Machine Learning (Part I) and Deep Learning (Part II). In Part I, students will explore classical machine learning techniques, including Support Vector Machines, Bayesian Modelling, Kernel Methods, and Ensemble Methods. Part II shifts the focus to Artificial Neural Networks and Deep Learning. To reinforce their learning, students will undertake a project applying the techniques acquired in Deep Learning.
